record.original_question: Let sigma_max(n) denote the maximum possible number of extensions of a semantics over all argumentation frameworks with n arguments. Determine sigma_max(n) for complete semantics: for each natural number n, what is the largest number of complete extensions that any n-argument argumentation framework can have?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
An (abstract) argumentation framework is a pair $F=(A,R)$ where $A$ is a finite set of arguments and $R\subseteq A\times A$ is an attack relation. For $S\subseteq A$, say that $S$ attacks $a\in A$ if there exists $b\in S$ with $(b,a)\in R$. A set $S\subseteq A$ is conflict-free if there are no $a,b\in S$ with $(a,b)\in R$. An argument $a\in A$ is defended by $S$ if, for every $b\in A$ with $(b,a)\in R$, there exists $c\in S$ with $(c,b)\in R$. The characteristic function $\mathcal{F}_F:2^A\to 2^A$ is defined by $\mathcal{F}_F(S)=\{a\in A:S\text{ defends }a\}$. A conflict-free set $S$ is a complete extension of $F$ if $S=\mathcal{F}_F(S)$ (equivalently, $S$ is admissible and contains every argument it defends).

For each positive integer $n$, let
$$\sigma_{\max}(n) := \max\{\,|\{S\subseteq A : S\text{ is a complete extension of }F\}|\ :\ F=(A,R)\text{ with }|A|=n\,\}.$$

Determine $\sigma_{\max}(n)$ as an explicit function of $n$, i.e., give a closed-form expression for the largest possible number of complete extensions of any argumentation framework on $n$ arguments.
artifact.status_search_result: The conjectured formula for the maximum number of complete extensions over all n-argument argumentation frameworks was confirmed by a combinatorial proof presented at KR 2021 ("On the Maximal Number of Complete Extensions in Abstract Argumentation Frameworks" by Ulbricht), thereby resolving the open problem.

status_evidence.title: On the Maximal Number of Complete Extensions in Abstract Argumentation Frameworks (KR2021)
status_evidence.snippet: Paper presents a combinatorial proof of the conjectured maximal number of complete extensions in abstract argumentation frameworks.
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture characterizing sigma_max for complete semantics is established.

status_evidence.title: On the Maximal Number of Complete Extensions in Abstract Argumentation (PDF)
status_evidence.snippet: Sections include 'The Conjecture', 'Preparatory Considerations', and 'A Combinatorial Proof'.
status_evidence.claim: A combinatorial proof of the conjectured bound is given in the paper.
